_comment: Slag separates (#236, owner 2026-08-18). This is the Separator's actual verb - one mixed feed
divided into distinct things - and slag is a mixture by definition: silica, alumina, lime and
iron oxides, whatever was not metal when the melt cooled.
Concrete powder because ground slag IS a cement. Blast-furnace slag ground fine is sold as GGBS
and substitutes for Portland cement in a large fraction of the world's concrete. No new item was
needed: Reinforced Concrete already drops concrete powder when broken, so this is the same
material arriving by manufacture instead of by demolition.
The byproduct is not decoration either. Steel slag is reprocessed to recover the metal droplets
trapped in it - that is a real industry, and it is why a scrapyard bothers to keep the slag.
